speaker: alse_pinder
text: Water, sir. The stair took the warm out of it on the second turning. I am not going back down to heat it a second time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will do. Leave the sheet. It is not for sanding, and it is not for carrying.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have a jug in my hands and I am not putting it down to discuss a letter. Dinner is when the light is properly up. If you are still at it then, I will call once.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Once is enough. There is a page after the letter. I am not promising it will be quiet.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The latch did not stick. I tried it, so you would not have to fight it with a full jug in the house. That is the whole of my news.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then it is a good latch and a cold stair, and both of them can be left alone. Drink the water. I am not sending her up again before dinner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not call her. The sheet stays on the board.
